Hi, i got a question..if i got a vampire in my torpor..damn it..
can i put a master card on him or do i have to wait , until i brought
him back to play ?

I hope you know an answer..greetings, Eva

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Karl-Rückert Eva <e912...@stud3.tuwien.ac.at> wrote:
> Hi, i got a question..if i got a vampire in my torpor..

> can i put a master card on him or do i have to wait , until i brought
> him back to play ?

You can play a master card on him (unless the master card specifies
a "ready" vampire). Being in torpor is still "in play" and is still
"controlled". The only thing that is different is that the vampire
is not "ready".

--
